note: The gateway does not write this log. glyph-worker calls.jsonl is dataset generation, not a live turn. Datadog tarx.connector.turn_ms is unwired (noopTelemetry in the Eve connector runtime) and is not this source.

fields.turn_id: Provider completion id from the gateway response.
fields.ask: Short label of the request. Do not store secrets or a full user prompt.
fields.model_text_before_gate: Model text before evidence-gate.ts. Null when the gateway only returns the buffered body.
fields.tool_stdout_present: y or n. Whether the returned body contains tool stdout.
